purpose: 02.2 replacement: select visual qualities from intact portraits before reconstructing an Earth renderer.

assets.credit: ESA (MPS for OSIRIS Team), MPS/UPD/LAM/IAA/RSSD/INTA/UPM/DASP/IDA; November 2009

display: Full original frames drawn with uniform scale and translation only. No image filtering, colour correction, masking, source crop, artificial light or projection. All source files retained unchanged. Globe bounds manually estimated; Rosetta dark extent inferred from arc.

conditions.Mercury: Production material r27, snapshot without advancing cached surface, shared upper-left hard-light
conditions.Venus: Production material r40.327526, shared upper-left hard-light and atmosphere
conditions.EarthLighting: Each source retains its own lighting, phase, weather and orientation. Not a common-Sun simulation.
conditions.limits: No city-light target, motion, future geography or render implementation established. None selected.
